text:
kate-ps: Heads up — DotBank POC kick-off tomorrow. One ask: they want PrivateLink + onprem proxy, but worried about source IP preservation and firewall rules. can netops weigh in?

sanjay-netops: I can take. quick q: are they using TGW or single VPC with a NAT?

marco-sales: They plan to route from their onprem -> customer edge -> our PrivateLink endpoint via a proxy in their VPC. no TGW. goal is that their audit logs show client IPs.

elaine-security: Important: bank wants end-to-end source IP in app logs for fraud detection. also need IOCs for IDS. will need to confirm if our proxy preserves X-Forwarded-For or if we can do TCP-level nat traversal.

sanjay-netops: PrivateLink terminates at an ENI in our service VPC. traffic originates from the customer's VPC ENI, so we see the customer's VPC IPs, not original onprem source. if they proxy through a NAT gateway, source becomes NAT EIP.

marco-sales: So what's the recommended architecture to satisfy their requirement?

sanjay-netops: Options: 1) Customer keeps a proxy in their VPC that sets X-Forwarded-For (HTTP) — easiest but relies on app reading header. 2) Use proxy in their onprem that uses TCP passthrough via LB with preserve client IP (only possible with NLB and cross-account). 3) Set up a dedicated Transit/VPC peering path so packets keep original private IPs — but with PrivateLink that's not typical.

elaine-security: From compliance: headers alone are okay if signed/immutable. they'd prefer cryptographic attestation (mTLS) and header signing. Can Redwood support mTLS client certs on the endpoint?

sanjay-netops: We support TLS termination at the service side and can require client certs (mTLS) on dedicated deployments. For hosted PrivateLink endpoints we can enforce TLS but cert provisioning will be via our managed CA — we can accept customer client certs if they use Dedicated or Private deployment.

kate-ps: DotBank is evaluating Dedicated capacity or Private (VPC) — so that should be workable.

marco-sales: Pricing question: does Dedicated + privatelink with static EIP / NAT costs factor into monthly commit or is egress billed separately? they asked for an estimate to include in their SOW.

sanjay-netops: Egress to customer's VPC over PrivateLink is not public egress, but Dedicated capacity pricing includes instance hours + data transfer inside region. if we need static NAT/EIPs in their VPC that's on their cloud bill. any cross-AZ/data processing on our side is included in Dedicated commit.

elaine-security: Also need a firewall rules snippet to give DotBank SecOps. can we provide minimal ALLOW list they can paste into their perimeter?

sanjay-netops: Sure — here's a minimal example for their outbound proxy/NAT to reach our PrivateLink (customer side):

```
# Customer VPC outbound rules (example)
# Allow from customer proxy instances -> our service ENI CIDR (provided per-POC)
Allow TCP 443 from 10.10.20.0/24 -> <service-eni-cidr>
Allow ICMP for path MTU checks 8/0 from 10.10.20.0/24 -> <service-eni-cidr>
# If using NLB target group health checks
Allow TCP 10256 from <aws-health-cidr> -> proxy-hosts
```

marco-sales: Nice. can you also add note about preserving XFF?

sanjay-netops: Add this to app/network docs: when using HTTP proxy, set X-Forwarded-For and configure app to trust only the proxy subnet. example nginx config: 

```
set_real_ip_from 10.10.20.0/24;
real_ip_header X-Forwarded-For;
```

elaine-security: For the security questionnaire: question on "Can you preserve original client IPs?" — proposed answer for POC: "Yes, when using Dedicated or Private deployment with customer-managed proxy, we can preserve client identity via mTLS and/or X-Forwarded-For headers. Raw TCP source IP preservation requires network-level peering decisions on the customer's side; consult netops."

kate-ps: Great — I'll add that wording to the security responses and include the firewall snippet.

marco-sales: Operational ask: can we provide a dedicated test ENI CIDR for the POC this week? DotBank wants to run connectivity tests Thu morning.

sanjay-netops: I can allocate a /28 from our POC pool. will need customer account id and region. send details to me and I'll provision and share the ENI IPs.

marco-sales: Sending acct id in DM.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: privatelink-poc-stub created for thread 2256001234 — ENI CIDR reserved 10.200.30.0/28 (provisional) :white_check_mark:

kate-ps: Perfect. next steps: I'll send the security responses + firewall snippet to DotBank, confirm whether they want XFF or mTLS, and loop netops if they need dedicated ENIs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

elaine-security: Quick follow: please ensure DotBank's SecOps gets contact for incident response (security@redwood.com) and our cert rotation plan in the SOW.

marco-sales: noted — I'll include contacts and draft SOW language.

kate-ps: closing the loop after Thu tests.
